Use case: illustration-story. Create a wordless landscape3:2 comic scene. Reference1 is exact Odette identity, reference2 continuity of collected diamonds and woven baskets, reference3 castle architecture only. Odette must exactly match reference1: childlike chibi mermaid, long flowing chestnut brown hair with lavender hairclip, huge BLUE eyes, cheerful face, FULLY COVERING high-neck pearly overlapping scallop-shell bodice joined to a lavender-to-aqua scaled mermaid tail with pink hearts, translucent lavender/aqua fins. No crown, no wand, no feet, no jumper, no bare torso. Polished luminous 3D children's-animation aesthetic matching references.
Scene: back inside HER underwater pearl castle, mermaid Odette is using the gathered diamonds to create an extraordinary diamond room. Show her actively fitting a large brilliant-cut diamond into a decorative golden shell-shaped wall setting with both hands, floating happily at working height. Several baskets brought from the mine sit nearby with remaining gems; other baskets already emptied. The room is clearly being transformed: a complete diamond mosaic already covers one wall, faceted diamond columns flank an arched sea window, smaller clear diamonds form a patterned floor inlay, a chandelier hung with diamond drops gleams overhead. Bare pearl-and-gold areas and a partially filled row of wall settings show work in progress. Make diamonds integral to the room's architecture, NOT merely piles on floor or a cave. She is the only character in this panel. Large bright faceted diamonds of varying sizes, warm white sparkle, prismatic rainbow flecks and reflected underwater light. Distinct soft reflections of Odette's blue/lavender tail and brown hair in nearby facets. Cozy welcoming room, coherent pearl castle architecture lavender/gold trim, turquoise sea through window, beautifully readable pose and face. No text, captions, letters, logos, watermark, borders or subdivisions.

Use case: illustration-story. One wordless cinematic wide16:9 comic scene revealing Odette's finished DIAMOND ROOM inside her underwater castle. Input1 is the immediately preceding construction panel: preserve its pearl/gold shell arches, diamond columns, floor mosaic and chandelier but room now complete. Input2 exact Odette identity. ALL gathered diamonds now fitted into architecture and ornaments; no baskets or piles left. Odette floats joyfully in centre-left, fullbody, arms gently outstretched admiring what she made. Character occupies about one third image height, architecture and reflections main focus.
User specifically asks bright, sparkling, SO MANY REFLECTIONS. Make this clearly visible: several large angled diamond-mirror wall facets visibly reflect Odette's face, brown hair and violet-blue tail at different perspectives, more facets reflect chandelier, windows and diamond columns; floor has a clear softly rippled full reflection of Odette, pillars reflected in faceted surfaces, recursive glints and prismatic rainbow caustic patterns dance across walls and floor. Multiple reflections should be legible to a child, not just generic sparkle.
Bright pearly white light with turquoise/lavender and warm gold accents, sun rays entering arched sea windows reflect and refract into tiny rainbows, brilliant star-shaped sparkles kept away from her face. Luxurious but welcoming enchanted room, polished luminous 3D animation, wide perspective with foreground faceted diamond edges, detail-rich yet composition clear. Through windows only ocean/coral/fishes, NO second castle outside. No other characters. NO text, captions, speech bubbles, labels, watermark, borders or multiple panels.
